titulo: Russian attacks on Ukraine leave 600,000 without power as Zelenskyy says Moscow ‘disrespecting’ US – Europe live
cuerpo: Zelenskyy says Russia attacked ‘infrastructure covered by the ceasefire announced by the American president’ Ukrainian soldiers have access to Starlink satellite internet restricted In the Q&A, Rutte gets asked about the growing speculations that the US intelligence sharing with Ukraine may have stopped , after Zelenskyy’s repeated complains that Kyiv had no notice of recent attacks. He says Trump “was very clear yesterday … that intelligence sharing has not stopped.” “ But here’s the main thing: we are stronger. Russia is not in a good place. These hybrid attacks, whatever it is, are a sign of weakness. What they allow us to do is to talk about it the whole day and to be rattled and to have press conferences on it. We’re not going to do that. We will react where we need to react.” “ Putin is trying to weaken our resolve and stop our support for Ukraine, but Russia is failing. It is failing on the battlefield in Ukraine and we will not be intimidated.” Continue reading...
